description: Catch-all empty catalog_search for the search-records suite. The skill's 0-hit lever and exhaustive-exit checklist name catalog_search, and the unit harness registers only tools a test has fixtures for, so without this a catalog call is an unregistered-tool abort. It answers 0 hits (placeResolved true) for every query, so the agent sees a Catalog that holds nothing for the place; no test's expected outcome depends on Catalog hits. `~` with an empty needle matches any call that carries the key; this one covers calls with a place, its sibling catalog-search-empty-keywords covers calls with keywords.
